versions.content: General scoping rules Hierarchy levels define the scoping and visibility of the names in ARMQL. The hierarchy level of ARMQL form a tree with the hierarchy level of all predefined names as its root. The scope of a name spans the hierarchy level it is defined in, as well as all sub hierarchy levels of this hierarchy level. Names can be redefined, i.e. within the scope of a name, a different value can be assigned to the name (exception: no redefinition within one LET block). This hides the previously defined name, i.e. the visibility of the previously defined name ends and so its value cannot be accessed any more in this hierarchy level and sub hierarchy levels of this hierarchy level. If a name is not redefined, its visibility corresponds to its scope.
